title: What Is the Repo Rate and How Does RBI's Monetary Policy Committee Decide It?
seoTitle: Repo Rate Explained: How RBI's MPC Decides It
seoDescription: The repo rate is what RBI charges banks for overnight loans. It is 5.50% after the MPC's 7 October 2026 hike; see how it moves your home-loan EMI.
excerpt: Repo, SDF and MSF in plain words, how the six-member MPC votes, the 4% inflation target to 2031, and a worked ₹50 lakh EMI example of a 0.25 point hike.
